name: Streamarr
description: Stream Usenet content on demand through the Streamarr Core Server. Thin adapter — no download-to-disk.
overview: Surfaces the Streamarr Core Server's Usenet search results inside Jellyfin and makes them playable through Jellyfin's transcoding pipeline.
changelog: Offline downloads in the Streamarr app. On phones, tablets and Android TV boxes you can download a movie, an episode or a whole season (as a season pack, "rest like this one" matched to the version you picked, or every episode chosen yourself). Only versions that play on that device as they are (natively or with VLC) are offered, versions that do not fit into the free space stay listed with the reason, and downloads resume after network loss, app kills, reboots and SD-card swaps. Without a server the app opens your downloads and plays them; watch progress syncs back later. Administrators get a Downloads permission and limits per viewer, an activity tab with revoke, and downloads never take bandwidth or slots from live streams. Playback: steadier start and resume positions, and with the Streamybox Player the app now asks the display for the film's frame rate, draws subtitles over its picture and offers the built-in player when it stutters. The container now uses .NET 8.0.33 (security fix). The iPhone/iPad and Android TV apps need a reinstall for this release (new native code; the app shows the update). The Jellyfin plugin code is unchanged.
